request.reason: The Runtime-admitted cargo test --locked --workspace exposed a real checked-in interface projection mismatch: cockpit-protocol's generated work-item-outcome reference reports package Runtime 1.0.1, while the three localized docs/reference/commands pages still say 1.0.1-rc.2. The test fails at checked_in_reference_regions_match_the_protocol_projection (language=en). Include only those three generated reference-page paths as protocol projections, preserve the exact 16 product/source paths, revise A1 and the scope boundary to distinguish product source from nine scoped documentation projections, and verify all three language regions. The attempt receipts and sandbox failures remain preserved.

changes.value: A1: The product/source diff changes exactly the 16 declared product paths. The nine additional scoped documentation paths are protocol projections only: three Work Item pages, three parity ledgers, and three localized generated command-reference pages. Workspace/package identity is plain stable SemVer 1.0.1; package, generated interface-version, and localized version/distribution guidance agree; historical v1.0.0 and v1.0.1-rc.2 identities remain separate.

Any product/source path outside the 16-path allowlist or any documentation projection path outside the nine declared Work Item, parity, and generated command-reference pages; .github/workflows/release.yml unless a demonstrated defect requires a separately admitted amendment; editing historical evidence; merging before exact-head CI and required review; tagging or publishing before Contract review and candidate acceptance.

Inspect Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, release metadata, package/version source, the exact 16 product/source paths, all three generated work-item-outcome reference regions in docs/reference/commands.md and its zh-CN/ja counterparts, and localized release/version documents; require every Runtime projection to report stable 1.0.1 and preserve historical v1.0.0 and rc.2 references.

acceptanceCriteria: A1: The product/source diff changes exactly the 16 declared product paths; the six additionally scoped files are only the required language/parity governance projections. Workspace/package identity is plain stable SemVer 1.0.1, localized version/distribution guidance is consistent, and historical v1.0.0 and v1.0.1-rc.2 identities remain separate.
A2: The stable 1.0.1 source has an independent technical review with no blocking product-code findings; attribute the conclusion to its actual reviewer (agent:Raydot), not human:Ray.

A3: Before any tag is created, a Runtime-bound release plan consumes fresh evidence for the exact current source/PR, confirms the existing public stable v1.0.0 tag and Release are the selected no-write N-1 reference, confirms the v1.0.1 tag and Release names are unused, records the provider's actual immutability metadata without overstating it, and confirms the existing workflow gates public Release publication on candidate checks.

After normal PR merge and fresh Runtime publication admission only, create the new immutable v1.0.1 tag on the accepted merge commit. The existing workflow must build and pass candidate install/smoke for aarch64-apple-darwin (Homebrew), x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, and staged full N-1 upgrade from stable v1.0.0 must pass on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu before public Release publication. Do not substitute N/A or another predecessor.

After public Release publication, download the official manifest, SHA256SUMS, and Linux x86_64 artifact; verify their identities and digests and pass public install plus N-1 upgrade from v1.0.0 with post-upgrade checks. Preserve any failure and never replace existing immutable assets.

On the local Apple Silicon macOS host, install the published macOS binary at the declared absolute path and update the CLI/MCP executable binding. Verify that official archive/manifest/SHA256SUMS agree, record the actual installed binary SHA-256 and version 1.0.1, confirm CLI absolute path and MCP initialize plus read-only request. Check a local build only for source/provenance/version; do not require its binary hash to equal the official artifact or mutate provider-global identity configuration.

After every release acceptance step succeeds, Runtime admits cleanup and close, and the exact merged PR branch/worktree cleanup plus final lifecycle receipts are recorded. No tag, release, or asset is overwritten or deleted.

Before marking PR #1022 ready or performing its normal merge, GitHub Actions must be fully successful for the exact current PR head after Runtime admits its hosted Work Item verification. This includes all required route, quality, Rust Contract, repository-gate and 13-package coverage, Windows Runtime, and behavioral-oracle checks. Preserve failed attempts; a changed head requires new exact-head CI.
